description: This Java source file defines the TenantModuleRootFilter class, which implements the IncludeAllFilter interface from Liquibase. It filters changelog files to include only those ending with 'module-changelog-master.xml'.

classes.name: TenantModuleRootFilter
classes.description: A filter class implementing Liquibase's IncludeAllFilter to include changelog files ending with 'module-changelog-master.xml'.

methods.name: include
methods.description: Checks if the provided changelog path ends with 'module-changelog-master.xml' to determine if it should be included.
